agronomicAdvice: Sigatoka proliferation intensifies during continuous leaf wetness and warm tropical showers.
Systematic de-leafing of infected banana leaves reduces ascospore dispersal.
Maintain plantation spacing of at least 2.5m x 2.5m to allow sunlight and wind penetration through the pseudostem canopy.
Apply systemic triazole or strobilurin fungicides in rotation with mineral oils to prevent chemical resistance.
